title: Generalized mean curvature transfers to the translated varifold
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, U any subset of R^(n+l), V a rectifiable n-varifold in U, xi in R^(n+l), tau(x) = x - xi, and V' a rectifiable n-varifold in tau(U) such that mu_V' = tau_# mu_V (V'.weight = Measure.map tau V.weight) and V'.tangentProj y = V.tangentProj (y + xi) for every y. If V has generalized mean curvature H in U (H locally mu_V-integrable on U and integral of div_M X dmu_V = - integral of <X, H> dmu_V for every C^1 compactly supported X with tsupport X contained in U), then V' has generalized mean curvature y -> H(y + xi) in tau(U).
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (ξ : Amb n ℓ) (V' : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ ((fun x => x - ξ) '' U)), V'.weight = V.weight.map (fun x => x - ξ) → (∀ y, V'.tangentProj y = V.tangentProj (y + ξ)) → ∀ H : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ, V.HasGeneralizedMeanCurvature H → V'.HasGeneralizedMeanCurvature (fun y => H (y + ξ))
